d.d: Of, belonging to, or relating to Mozambique or its people.
A native or inhabitant of Mozambique, or a descendant of such person.
Any of various kinds of dress material.
A native or inhabitant of Mozambique; a Mozambican.
A country in East Africa and Southern Africa. Official name: Republic of Mozambique (since 1990). Capital: Maputo.
By analogy with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a musical virtuoso.
By extension, a virtuoso in any field.
Soft Italian or Italian-style cheese made from cow's or buffalo's milk and commonly used as a pizza topping and in salads etc.
